summary: First-run end-to-end test of Root Record Weather Manager mobile PWA. Backend (22 pytest cases) and Frontend (auth gate -> guest -> add location via map -> dashboard with current temp/bento/hourly/alerts -> hazards tabs -> settings units toggle + location delete) all pass cleanly. Real upstream weather/hazard feeds (NOAA, USGS, NASA EONET, Environment Canada GeoMet) returned live data during the test. License-API auth proxy correctly returns 4xx on bogus credentials and 401 on missing token; no real account creation attempted.

minor.issue: Upstream Cloudflare Workers returns HTTP 404 for invalid token instead of 401. Proxy correctly forwards the 4xx but a 401 would be more semantically correct. Consider remapping non-2xx -> 401 in /auth/me when the upstream comes back with anything in the 4xx range so clients always see a consistent unauthorized status.

issues: Email/password inputs lack a visible required-field marker; minor — error text appears only on submit.
React Router v7 future-flag warnings logged in console (cosmetic, not blocking).

action_items: (Optional) Normalize /api/auth/me upstream 4xx -> 401 for consistent client behavior.
(Optional) Silence React Router future-flag warnings by passing the v7 future flags to BrowserRouter.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 623-line file. As more endpoints are added it should be split into routers/ (auth, locations, weather, hazards, dashboard) and a services/ layer for upstream calls.

USGS earthquakes feed is fetched on every dashboard request without caching. Add a small in-process TTL cache (e.g. 60s) for /weather/* and /usgs/* to reduce duplicate upstream calls and respect NOAA's User-Agent rate-limit guidance.
Frontend api.js stores the bearer token in localStorage. Acceptable for an MVP PWA but XSS-exposed; flag for follow-up if/when third-party scripts are added.
AuthGate does only client-side password length check (>=6); upstream Cloudflare Workers /license/signup likely enforces stronger rules — surface those errors verbatim (already done via err state).

Home.js deeply reaches into bundle.current.observation.* with optional chaining only — fine, but consider a small selector/normalizer helper so unit conversion (units=imperial vs metric from Settings) actually wires into the displayed hero temp/wind/visibility (currently the Units toggle in Settings only cosmetically flips its own label; Home.js still shows raw NOAA °C/km/h values).

Settings 'Units' toggle persists rrwm.units in localStorage but Home.js never reads it. This is a real UX gap: the toggle does not change how values are rendered. Recommended fix: read units from localStorage in Home.js (and Hazards if relevant) and pass to fmtTemp/fmtSpeedKmH.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md missing — not required for this MVP. Auth uses real Cloudflare Workers (do not seed accounts). Guest mode used as primary flow.
seed_data_creation: Test guest IDs prefixed with TEST were used; locations created during testing were deleted by the delete-location test. No residual seed data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. They depend on live upstream feeds (NOAA NWS, USGS, NASA EONET, Environment Canada). If upstream rate-limits or is down, expect intermittent failures on TestWeather/TestUSGS/TestEONET. Frontend testing strategy: pre-seed localStorage 'rrwm.guestAccepted'='1' to skip AuthGate, then exercise /locations/new to create a location before navigating to / or /settings. The Units toggle bug (Settings persists value but Home does not consume it) is the most impactful UX gap to fix.
rca of the issue: No critical issues to RCA. Minor: /auth/me returning 404 for invalid token is upstream behavior (Cloudflare Workers /license/prepare endpoint returns 404 when token is unknown). Mitigation already documented in action items.
